applies_to: SICAM P (7KG7xxx) power meters with the Modbus serial interface, per manual E50417-B1076-C241-A5 (release 11.2012).
summary: SICAM P is a panel power meter and power-quality monitor with an RS-485 Modbus slave (RTU or ASCII) on a 9-pin D-sub socket. Every measured value occupies two holding registers and is sent as an IEEE float by default. This map covers device identity, the format switch, time sync, binary I/O and command bits, all measured values, the 5th-19th and 2nd/3rd/21st harmonics, energy values, alarm counters and analog I/O.

addressing.note: The manual prints Modicon holding-register numbers (40001, 40201...). Subtract 40001 for the wire address: 40201 (voltage L1-N) is requested as address 200. Bit-coded registers are printed as 'register / 2^n', meaning bit n of that register.

source.title: Power Meter SICAM P Modbus Manual
source.pages: bus parameters p. 11; functions p. 13; data types pp. 17-21; register map pp. 23-43

notes: Word order: the manual says the lower register of a multi-register value holds the most significant byte, so floats and the unsigned-long alarm counters are high word first (ABCD).

All float registers assume the default float format (40050 = 0). In integer format only the first register of each pair is used and the value must be multiplied by a range-dependent factor (table 5-1, which depends on the measuring ranges and CT/VT setup); that mode is not mapped.
Energy values are listed with data type 'measured value', so in float mode they are floats in Wh/varh/VAh.

Bits 2-5 of 40129 are BO3-BO6, but which output each bit drives depends on which RO/BO modules are fitted in slots A and B (four layouts in the manual); check the table on pp. 24-25 for your hardware.
Only rows printed individually are listed for harmonic block 2. The 4th-20th harmonic voltages (40512-40612) and currents (40632-40732) are printed only as ranges, so they are left out.
The harmonic currents of block 1 (5th-19th) are in A; the harmonic currents of block 2 (2nd, 3rd, 21st) are printed in %.

Left out: serial number 40020-40030 (the printed range is 11 registers for a 20-character string), and the limit-value group parameters 41000-41209 (packed byte fields; needs the full table on pp. 36-42).
Analog inputs AI_A12 to AI_D34 depend on fitted AI modules; on 7KG775x only slot A. Only AO_A12/AO_A34 (40967/40969) are writable.
Broadcast (address 0) is accepted for FC 06 and FC 16 writes, not for reads.

integration.summary: Set the Modbus address, baud and parity on the device, then read holding registers (FC 03) from 40201 (wire 200) in float format. Values come as big-endian floats, two registers each; keep 40050 at 0 unless you want scaled integers.
integration.enable: The Modbus serial interface is a hardware variant of the meter. Slave address (1-247), baud, parity and RTU/ASCII mode are set in the device parameters (on the device or with SICAM P PAR).
quirks: Modicon numbering: subtract 40001 for the wire address.
Register 40050 switches all measured values between float and 16-bit integer; the setting survives power-off.
Max 125 registers per read in RTU (60 in ASCII).
setup: Slave address 1-247; 300-115200 baud; parity even/odd/none in RTU (even/odd only in ASCII per the technical data); always 1 stop bit.
RS-485 on a 9-pin D-sub: pin 3 = A, pin 8 = B, pin 5 = GND, pin 6 = +5 V for termination.
Up to 32 devices per segment without repeaters.
gotchas: Writing a read-only register returns exception 03, not 02.
Switch binary outputs by read-modify-write of 40129; only outputs with no assigned function can be controlled.
Time sync (40065-40068) must be written with FC 16 as a broadcast.
